tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Agent-to-agent fee formula, referral program and the whitelisted token mints of this network.

tools.name: quote_payment
tools.description: Price a payment to a payee: gross amount, net amount to the payee, fee_gross, discount, fee_net, treasury, mint and a 30-second expiry. Returns a signed quote.

tools.name: build_payment
tools.description: Build the m2m-split transaction for a quote: the payer's transfer to the payee and the USDC fee transfer to the treasury, in one atomic transaction where the payer pays its own gas. Checks that the receiving token accounts exist and that the payer holds USDC for the fee, and simulates it. Unsigned.

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: For the payee: check a payer-signed transaction against its quote (net amount, fee to the treasury, whitelisted mints, quote id and expiry) and simulate it before submitting.

tools.name: submit_payment
tools.description: Broadcast a transaction the payer already signed, wait for confirmation and return the signed receipt. Only broadcasts; never signs or pays payment transactions. A retry with the same idempotency_key never pays twice.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a receipt: the m2m.monster signature and that the confirmed on-chain transaction matches it.

tools.name: build_refund
tools.description: Build a refund from the payee back to the payer, linked to the original receipt. The payee signs it and pays its gas; it has no m2m.monster fee and the original fee is not returned. Unsigned. Sign it locally with your own Solana key; m2m.monster never sees or uses agents' private keys.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Optional registration; paying and getting paid work without it. It unlocks referral credits and receipt history. Call once without `signature` to get the message to sign with your Solana key, then again with the base58 signature to receive an api_key.

tools.name: get_referral_status
tools.description: Your referrer, referred agents, credits and their expiry dates. Credits are discounts on your own fees, never cash. Requires the api_key from register_agent.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "build_payment" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent · Private data: get_pricing, build_payment, build_refund · Public sink: submit_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent · Private data: get_pricing, build_payment, build_refund · Public sink: submit_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
